protocol.spacing: 1 second around the middle when the clip is at least 2.2 seconds, otherwise spread across the clip
protocol.hmdb51: Test list packaged with Sina272/hmdb51-v4 (30 clips per class when complete).
protocol.matcher: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 mean-pool cosine, argmax over class sentences.
protocol.latency: Sum of pixel checks, SmolVLM generates, Qwen generates, and phrase-encoder calls used for that clip. No network round-trip.
protocol.smol_runtime: PyTorch float32 on this machine. This is not the phone WebGPU timing.
protocol.note: A sparse three-frame phrase is not the official video accuracy of either dataset.
